Description: Extract a detailed structured summary of a staging CT report, covering every organ system the report describes.

modality.description: The imaging modality and the region covered

contrast.description: Contrast administration, as described in the technique

image_quality.description: The report's own assessment of image quality

comparison_date.description: Date of the prior study used for comparison

clinical_history.description: The presenting complaint and its duration

lung_findings.description: Findings in the lungs and airways

liver_findings.description: Findings in the liver and biliary system

pancreas_findings.description: Findings in the pancreas, spleen and adrenals

kidney_findings.description: Findings in the kidneys and urinary tract

bowel_findings.description: Findings in the bowel and peritoneum

largest_lesion_mm.description: Size in millimetres of the largest measured lesion

largest_lesion_site.description: Anatomical site of the largest measured lesion

lesion_count.description: How many lesions are individually measured

new_lesions.description: Whether any lesion is described as newly apparent

growing_lesions.description: Whether any lesion is described as having increased

impression_summary.description: The impression, summarised in one sentence

recommendation.description: The recommendation given at the end of the report
